entries.dc3fcf44b0e419c1: Under its management philosophy of “Living in Harmony with Nature,” it states that it will advance the realization of a “green economy” in which the economy restores the environment. The pillars of its growth strategy are the development of its açaí business and the building of a sustainable matching platform. In Japan, it is advancing the “Making Açaí a Daily Food” strategy to consolidate its demand base, and it states that in the current fiscal year it built the supply structure for full-scale entry into Asian markets centered on China as a pillar for the fiscal year ending March 2027.
entries.dd1d0badc2be0ab8: The company has an exclusive sales agreement in Japan with CAMTA for frozen pulp of açaí and other fruits, and it is CAMTA's general agent in Japan. It states that for its açaí raw material it uses only Grosso, the highest grade under the Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture's standards. Because CAMTA has a juice extraction and processing plant and a cold storage warehouse, and has independently established and practices agroforestry farming, it can directly import açaí, which oxidizes quickly, in the form of frozen pulp and process and sell it in Japan and Taiwan while maintaining its quality.
